title: Camps, Quarters, and Casual Places

authorInfo.bio: Archibald Forbes (1838–1900) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Camps, Quarters, and Casual Places" by Archibald Forbes is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book explores various facets of military life during pivotal moments in history, particularly focusing on the Franco-German War and British colonial experiences, detailing the intertwining of warfare, culture, and human relationships.
